title: Three new HTTP handlers (handle_start/handle_skip/handle_re_enable) have zero direct test coverage; integration tests call only the inner functions
evidence: router.gleam routes the three new POST arms to the handlers: "371:      trigger.handle_start(", "398:      trigger.handle_skip(", "426:      trigger.handle_re_enable(". But every test in reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam invokes only inner functions: "215:  let outcome = trigger.run_create_checks(config, app, landlord, vacancy)", "364:  let resp = trigger.do_skip(config, app, landlord, vacancy, \"employer_ref\")", "439:  let resp = trigger.do_re_enable(config, app, landlord, \"employer_ref\")". No test calls handle_start/handle_skip/handle_re_enable. By contrast the mirrored handle_update_status has an HTTP-level negative test: application_integration_test.gleam:170 "application_detail_handler.handle_update_status(" ... "178:  resp.status |> should.equal(404)".
detail: 3 new authenticated endpoints have 0 HTTP-level coverage. run_action_with_prechecks (ownership 404, archived 422), is_valid_slot (400), parse_app_uuids (400) and all branded responses are unverified. The defended ownership/authz invariant has no negative test on these arms.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests that call handle_start/handle_skip/handle_re_enable directly: a cross-tenant 404 (mirror cross_tenant_application_status_update_returns_not_found_test), an archived-vacancy 422, an unknown-slot 400, and a happy-path 200 each.

title: Production hook maybe_trigger_reference_checks and its Viewed-only dispatch branch are never exercised by any test
detail: The actual production wiring (PATCH status→viewed→reference_call rows) is unasserted end-to-end. The dispatcher's Viewed-vs-other branch and its fail-open Sentry path are untested; integration tests prove core logic but not that it fires on the right transition.
recommended_fix: Add one integration test that calls handle_update_status with status="viewed" on an application seeded with referee trios and asserts reference_call rows + reference_call_created audit appear — exercising the real hook path.

title: Unit test file trigger_test.gleam named as a spec deliverable did not ship
evidence: Spec Tasks list: "- [ ] `server/test/reference_checks/trigger_test.gleam` — unit tests: slot selection (rented vs never-rented), no-contact skip, declined suppression, pre-v1 allowed, double-trigger idempotency, pre-excluded-slot respected, audit-on-create, declined-manual-start suppression". `ls server/test/reference_checks/` returns only `schema_migration_test.gleam`; `find server/test -name '*trigger*'` returns only the integration file. The Suggested Review Order also references ../../server/test/reference_checks/trigger_test.gleam.
detail: A spec-named deliverable (the unit test file) is absent. The same behaviours are covered at DB level by reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam, so this is a deliverable/process gap, not a behaviour gap.
recommended_fix: Either ship trigger_test.gleam with the listed unit cases, or update the spec's Tasks/Review-Order to record that integration coverage substitutes for the unit file.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: P0 behaviours (slot selection landlord/character, no-contact skip, declined suppression, pre-v1, ON CONFLICT idempotency, audit-on-create) are FULL via reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam (lines 215-457 call run_create_checks/do_skip/do_re_enable). P1 behaviours are largely NONE: the 3 HTTP handlers, the ownership/archived prechecks, slot validation, UUID parse, and the maybe_trigger_reference_checks dispatcher are all untested; only re-enable-404 (line 457) and declined-suppression are covered through inner functions. P1 ≈ 25%. Overall, blending fully-covered DB logic with the uncovered HTTP/auth/dispatcher layer, ≈ 65%.
detail: Gate thresholds require P0 100% AND P1 ≥80% AND overall ≥80%. P1 (~25%) and overall (~65%) fall below. Core business rules are well-pinned, but the HTTP/authz wrapper for 3 new endpoints and the production hook wiring are not — both named as blind-spots in this lens.
recommended_fix: Add HTTP-level integration tests for handle_start/handle_skip/handle_re_enable (happy 200 + cross-tenant 404 + archived 422 + unknown-slot 400) and one end-to-end viewed-PATCH-creates-rows test through the real hook. That lifts P1 above 80% and overall above 80%.
